text: Hello — Diego (grad student, Prof. Alvarez's advisee). Could you confirm in writing whether the faculty senate meeting this Wednesday, 18 November 2026, at 10:00 is cancelled this week? I'd like to set up a 30-minute meeting with Prof. Alvarez at that hour, but only if the senate slot is really free. Thanks!

Hello Diego. No — the faculty senate meeting on Wednesday 18 November, 10:00–11:00, is on as scheduled; nothing in the official schedule has been cancelled or moved this week. That hour is therefore not free.

Official events are fixed, and only this office confirms a cancellation. Also, this office keeps the schedule but does not arrange meetings; please take a free hour up with Prof. Alvarez directly.

Hello Professor Alvarez — a correction on the 30-minute meeting I wanted to set for Wednesday at 10:00. I checked with the department office: your faculty senate meeting on Wednesday 18 November, 10:00–11:00, is on as scheduled, and nothing in the official schedule was cancelled or moved this week. So that hour is not free — my mistake.

Could we meet in a slot that works for you? For example Wednesday 18 November, 11:00–11:30 (right after the senate), or Thursday 19 November, 10:00–10:30. Just tell me which one fits and I'll put it on my calendar and confirm with you.
Thanks for the quick and clear answer — I'll take a free hour up with Prof. Alvarez directly.

Thank you for checking with the office, Diego — you are right, the faculty senate is on as scheduled on Wednesday 10:00–11:00.

Both slots you propose are already taken: Wednesday 11:00–12:30 is grant writing, and Thursday 09:00–10:30 is the CSE455 lecture, so 10:00–10:30 falls inside it.

Free half hours that week: Wednesday 12:30–13:00, Thursday 10:30–11:00, or Thursday 12:00–12:30. Pick one and I will put it on my calendar and confirm.
Let's take Wednesday 12:30–13:00. I've put it on my calendar: 30 minutes, Wednesday 18 November 2026, 12:30–13:00, with you. Please confirm once it's on yours.
Confirmed: Wednesday 18 November, 12:30–13:00, with you — it is on my calendar and logged. See you then.
Great — logged on my side too. See you Wednesday at 12:30.
